sections.title: Safety is the priority, excellence is the standard.
sections.intro: Rope Access Center (RAC) is the rope access training and services brand of the Inland group. Since 2024 we have run Kemnaker-certified work-at-height training, alongside work at height for buildings and industry.

items.title: Safety First
items.text: Every decision is tested against one question: does everyone go home whole?

items.title: By the Regulation
items.text: Programmes follow Ministry of Manpower Regulation 9/2016 and close with a Kemnaker RI competency test.

items.title: Field Experience
items.text: A team that maintains buildings day to day with Inland — what we teach is what we do.
